title: Mini Facials in Ocala, FL | Express Glo | GLO Aesthetics
meta: Mini facials in Ocala, FL: our 30-minute Express Glo cleanses, exfoliates and hydrates with no downtime, from $75. Book your quick glow at GLO Aesthetics.
answer: A mini facial is a short, refreshing skin treatment that cleanses, gently exfoliates and hydrates your skin for a quick glow. It suits busy schedules, monthly maintenance between deeper treatments and pre-event prep. GLO's Express Glo takes about 30 minutes, has no downtime and you can put makeup on and return to your day right away.
treats_h2: What does a mini facial treat?
treats_intro: A mini facial treats everyday dullness, mild congestion and dehydrated skin, and gives you a fast glow before a big day — without the time of a full facial.
how_h2: How does a mini facial work?
how: GLO's Express Glo mini facial follows a short, focused sequence. After a quick skin check, your provider cleanses away oil and buildup, then uses light exfoliation to lift dull surface cells so your skin looks brighter. A hydrating mask finishes the treatment to restore moisture and glow. It skips the extended massage and multi-step masking of a full facial, so it fits into about 30 minutes and works best as maintenance.
fit_h2: Is a mini facial right for me?
good_fit: You want a quick glow in about 30 minutes
Your skin feels dull, dry or a little congested
You have an event coming up and want to look fresh
You'd like easy monthly maintenance between deeper treatments
not_fit: You have an active skin infection, open wounds or a cold sore flare
You're sunburned or your skin is irritated right now
You want to treat a specific concern like pigmentation or stubborn congestion — a Custom Facial or Peel is the better fit
Your main concern is fine lines, scarring or texture — microneedling may be the better fit
expect_h2: What happens during a mini facial appointment?
expect_intro: A mini facial takes about 30 minutes: a quick skin check, cleansing and light exfoliation, then a hydrating mask. You can wear makeup and get back to your day right away.

faq_add.q: How long does a mini facial take?
faq_add.a: About 30 minutes. Our Express Glo mini facial is thoughtfully designed to fit into a lunch break or a busy day, with no downtime afterward.

faq_add.q: When should I get a mini facial before an event?
faq_add.a: A day or two before your event works well for most people. Because a mini facial uses only light exfoliation and has no downtime, your skin looks fresh and hydrated without any peeling.

faq_add.q: Is a mini facial good for sensitive skin?
faq_add.a: Often, yes. A mini facial uses gentle cleansing, light exfoliation and hydration. Let your provider know about any sensitivity, rosacea or products you use so the treatment can be adjusted for your skin.
